concepts.name: Direction A: Focus Lanes on Unciv's Era Grid
concepts.one_line: Unciv's own research tree, with its rows turned into 33 focus lanes. The eras stay as Unciv's amber, teal and charcoal columns, with the teal band behind the current era. Breakthroughs are auto-width compact tech buttons: gold if owned, steel blue if under study, dashed teal if awaiting the idea, a dotted charcoal "shuttered window" if its moment passed. Every lane has a radio button that funds it in one click, and Unciv's Close | description | action bar sits underneath.

concepts.status_encoding:
BASE PILL (a compact Unciv tech button)
- Height 24, auto width, radius 12, border 1.5 px, name at 14 px. The pill grows to fit its name: none is ellipsised. Measured widths run up to 281 px; the median name is 113 px at 14-px DejaVu, and 67 names exceed Unciv's 140-px ellipsis.
- Owned pills: padding 0 10.
- Revealed pills: an 18-px glyph slot at the left (padding 0 10 0 4, then a 6 px gap). This plays the role of Unciv's portrait.
- Gaps are 6 px horizontal and 4 px vertical.
- Hover turns the border #FFFFFF.
- Each pill is a <button> with an aria-label of the form 'Superconductivity, its moment passed, only an Endeavour is certain, Electricity, Atomic era'.
- Glyphs are 12-px inline stroke SVG: stroke 1.5, round caps.

1. OWNED (Discovered). Fill #FFD700, Unciv's ResearchedTechColor. Solid #B3B3B3 border. Name #7B4E0D, which is Unciv's #9A6210 darkened about 20%: 5.10:1, where Unciv's own value is only 3.63:1. No glyph. It is the only light pill (relative luminance 0.70).

2. REVEALED, BEING STUDIED. Fill #4893AF, Unciv's CurrentTechColor. Solid #B3B3B3 border. Name navy #000033 at 5.79:1; Unciv's white would be 3.46:1. Glyph: a white 18-px portrait disc with a 1.5 px navy ring and a navy flask, the Insight/science glyph. Luminance 0.25. There is no progress mark, bar, percentage or turn count, because the meter is hidden.

3. REVEALED, NOT YET OCCURRED. Fill #0E5C56, Unciv's QueuedTechColor. Border 1.5 px dashed #FFFFFF. Name #FFFFFF at 7.82:1. Glyph 'seed': a dashed white ring (r 4.5, dash 2.2/1.6) with a 3-px white centre dot. Luminance 0.084.
   Variant 3b, REVEALED, NEEDS PREREQUISITES (R69). Same body, but the glyph is a 'missing link' (one solid and one dashed rounded link). Its action button reads 'Needs Dirigible/Airship', disabled.

4. REVEALED, WINDOW CLOSED. Label: 'Its moment passed — only an Endeavour is certain'; the chip short form is 'Moment passed'. The shape changes from a pill to a window: radius 4, fill #111111 (Unciv's CHARCOAL), border 1.5 px dotted #9A9A9A, name #B3B3B3 at 9.01:1 (6.98:1 on the band). Glyph 'shutter': a 9-px rounded square with two horizontal slats, in #B3B3B3.

5. PATH NOT TAKEN (Competing Solutions lock-out). A faded ghost: no fill, radius 12, border 1 px dashed #6A6A8C, name #9C9CB4 (7.47:1 on navy, 5.46:1 on the band). Glyph: a fork with its right branch cut.
   The same ghost body carries these spec-only variants, none of which occur in the data:
   - closed for good by a negative prerequisite (R73): 'no-entry' glyph;
   - known dead end, a revealed rival theory reported against: '⊣' glyph;
   - UNIQUE claimed by a rival (R76): crossed-star glyph.

6. GRAND ENDEAVOUR TARGET. This overrides statuses 2 to 5. Fill #334D80, Unciv's button blue. Border 2.5 px solid #FFFFFF. Name #FFFFFF at 8.35:1. Glyph: a white disc with a navy pyramid, for a wonder.
   - A 3 px bar sits inside the bottom edge, inset 10 px: track rgba(255,255,255,.25), white fill at the exact percentage, and 1-px navy ticks at 25, 50 and 75% for the spin-off milestones.
   - It is the only pill that carries a progress bar.
   - Spec: an abandoned Endeavour keeps its base status body, with the bar in #9A9A9A on a dashed track and a 'pause' badge.

BADGES ON OWNED PILLS
Each adds 18 px in the right slot: a 12-px glyph in #7B4E0D.
- RARE: hollow diamond (AE09, CH15).
- UNIQUE: filled five-point star (WM09).
- SUPERSEDED: curved 'replaced' arrow (WM11, FA16).
- DEAD-ENDED: '⊣' (TH09).
- Traded or stolen (R132, spec only): '75%' or '50%' at 14 px after a 1-px divider.

OVERLAYS (no extra width)
- NEW THIS TURN: a 9-px white dot with a 2-px navy ring on the pill's top-right corner. It also marks status changes this turn: PH14 owned, SF12 newly 'moment passed'. A newly opened focus gets the same dot after its lane name.
- SELECTED: a 2-px #FFFFFF outline, offset 2 px. The pill's shown prerequisites get a 1.5-px dashed white outline, and Unciv connector lines are drawn (see detail_and_actions).

TOLD APART WITHOUT HUE
- Fill luminance steps: 0.70 owned, then 0.25 being studied, then 0.084 not yet occurred, then 0.006 moment passed, then none (ghost). Adjacent steps differ by 2.47:1, 2.26:1 and 2.41:1.
- Moment passed and ghost are only 1.06:1 apart in fill. They are separated by shape: a window body against a pill, dotted against dashed borders, a solid dark body against none, and different text tones and glyphs.
- Border pattern: solid for owned and being studied, dashed for not yet occurred and ghosts, dotted for moment passed, thick white for the Endeavour.
- Every revealed status has its own glyph. Owned has none.
- The status is also always named in text: the chips, the description title and the aria-label.

FRAME COLOURS
- Era headers (Unciv): past #FFAF00 with label #782E10 (5.18:1 at 18 px); current #0E5C56 with white (7.82); future #111111 with white (18.9). All have a 1-px white frame.
- Lane radio:
  - Off: a 22-px ring, 2 px #B3B3B3.
  - On: fill #4893AF, 2-px white ring, 8-px white dot.
  - Queued: Unciv's queue disc, #32659D (baseColor at 75% alpha over navy), a 1.5-px white ring and a white 14-px number (6.03:1).
- Funded lane: header fill #16305E (white 12.97:1), a 3-px white bar on the header's left edge, and a grid wash of rgba(72,147,175,.16).
- Buttons (Unciv skin): up #334D80 with white (8.35); hover #65DC72 with #404040 (5.94); pressed #409955; disabled #252B3E with white (14.06). Radius 20, 18-px labels.
- Secondary text: #B3B3B3 on navy (9.56).
concepts.funding:
ONE TARGET, CHOSEN LIKE A RADIO BUTTON (R48)
Each lane header has a radio: a real <button role="radio">, 22-px visual with a 34-px x lane-height hit area. One click funds that focus. That is a single action, which matters because players switch focus every 2 to 4 turns.
- Exactly one radio is on.
- The funded lane is also marked by its #16305E header, a 3-px white bar and a blue wash across the grid.
- The funding header names the focus.
- Selecting a focus by clicking its name offers 'Fund Quantum Physics' as the action button, which is Unciv's select-then-act path.
- Double-clicking a focus name funds it and closes the screen, which is Unciv's double-click confirm.

FUNDING HEADER (0,0 236x68, a <button>)
- Line 1, 18 px white: flask glyph and '853 Insight a turn'.
- Line 2, 14 px: an '80%' chip (34x18, fill #4893AF, navy text), then 'Quantum Physics' in white, with '683' right-aligned at x 200-226.
- Line 3, 14 px #B3B3B3: a '20%' chip (1-px dashed #B3B3B3 outline), then 'Spread to other foci', with '171' right-aligned.
- Figures are 853.3, 682.7 and 170.7, shown rounded.
- Before Specialization of Labor (SO05) the chips read 50% and 50%.

Clicking the header shows the funding details in the description:
- 'Insight is your science, 853 a turn.'
- '80% goes to the funded focus since Specialization of Labor (turn 35); 50% before it.' (R49 credit)
- 'The other 20% keeps flowing to other foci with work under study, so unfunded work still moves.' (R50). This shows the total only; there are no per-focus figures, as decided.
- 'Switching focus loses nothing: work under study keeps its progress.' (critic)
- The queue order.
- 'Knowledge diffusion: after the press, since Printing Press (turn 140)' (R130).
- 'Theory reveals its applications since Scientific Method' (critic).
- The abilities: 'Experiment (Scientific Method)' and 'Synthesis (Dialectical Thinking): available this era' (R103).

QUEUE (R51)
- Unciv's numbered queue discs replace the radio on queued lanes. The funded focus is slot 1 (radio on); queued foci show 2, 3 and so on. In the turn-226 mockup: 2 Energy Systems, 3 Relativity & Cosmology.
- Right-click a radio (Unciv's 'append to queue') or long-press it to add or remove that focus.
- With a focus selected, the secondary action is 'Add to queue' or 'Remove from queue', and the description lists the order with Move up and Move down buttons.
- The rule is stated once: 'If the funded focus stalls, funding moves to the next focus in the queue.' There is no stall indicator.

GRAND ENDEAVOUR IN THE SLOT (R52, R106, artboard 3)
- No radio is on.
- Header line 2 becomes an '80%' chip (#334D80, white text, 1-px white ring), a pyramid glyph, 'Superconductivity', and '64%' at the right.
- Under it runs a 4-px white bar with ticks at 25, 50 and 75%.
- Line 3 is unchanged ('20% Spread to other foci 171'): the spread continues, and the Endeavour takes only the active share.
- Queue discs read 2 Quantum Physics and 3 Energy Systems: the order in which funding resumes.
- The Electricity lane name gets a 14-px pyramid glyph.
- Clicking any radio opens an Unciv confirmation popup (the critic's fix to R52): 'Fund Quantum Physics instead? The Superconductivity Endeavour stops at 64%. Its progress decays slowly while stopped, and you can resume it.' Buttons: [Fund Quantum Physics] [Keep the Endeavour].
- An FTL prototype (R113) would use the same header with its drive name, and no viability information.

ENDEAVOUR PRICE
I made the numbers consistent across the two states. Committing on turn 226 shows 5,340 Insight, 'about 8 turns at 683 a turn'. On turn 231 that is 3,415 of 5,340 Insight (5 turns × 683), which is 64% with about 3 turns left.
concepts.breakthrough_display:
MEASURED FROM late_game_state.json
- 246 rows: 193 owned, 26 being studied, 3 not yet occurred, 24 window closed.
- By era: Primitive 35, Ancient 43, Classical 22, Medieval 29, Early Modern 40, Modern 53, Atomic 20, Space 4.
- By focus: 1 (Computing, Genetics, Materials Science) up to 16 (Chemistry, Construction, Warfare); Philosophy and the Arts has 15.
- 33 foci entered. Space Engineering is not yet entered, and Quintessic Physics is impossible in an atomic world.
- The data spells it 'Philosophy And The Arts'; the screen uses the design's 'Philosophy and the Arts'.
- Densest cells: Chemistry×Modern 11; Foraging×Primitive 6; 5 each in Warfare×Ancient, Warfare×Medieval, Stonework×Primitive, Observation×Primitive, Thermodynamics×Early Modern and Quantum Physics×Atomic.
- Names at 14-px DejaVu: median 113 px, 90th percentile 173, maximum 239 ('Nanotechnology / Fine Structuring').
- Prerequisite links among visible rows: 474, of which 273 (58%) cross foci and 320 cross eras. Drawing them all, as Unciv does, would be unreadable, so lines are drawn for the selection only.

CONTENT CORRECTIONS (the critic's MUST)
The simulator does not model lock-outs, theory reveals, dead ends or environmental gating, so I corrected the content:
- CO05 Corbel Arch/Vault and WA08 Chariot Warfare become PATH NOT TAKEN: their primaries, Arch Construction (turn 38) and Cavalry Tactics (turn 89), came first.
- WM11 Industrial Canal Network and FA16 Nitrate Fertiliser become owned and SUPERSEDED, by Railway Network and Catalysis.
- TH09 Caloric Theory becomes owned and DEAD-ENDED: Mechanical Equivalent of Heat (turn 188) reported a kinetic world.
- TH08 and CH09-W 'persist' and remain plain owned rows.
- Three theory-revealed NOT YET OCCURRED rows are added: MD20 Phage Therapy (Medicine, Modern; competes with Antibiotics, which is under study), ES05 Oil Power Plant (Energy Systems, Modern) and RK09 Ion Drive (Rocketry, Space).
- One R69 row is added: AE13 Rigid Airship (Aeronautics, Modern), 'seen in use by another civilisation', which needs Dirigible/Airship.
- Result: 250 rows. 191 owned, 26 being studied, 7 not yet occurred (one of them needing prerequisites), 24 moment passed, 2 path not taken.
- In the turn-231 state, EL11 becomes the Endeavour target. Its counts are 194 / 24 / 6 / 23 / 2 / 1.

LAYOUT
Each (lane, era) cell is a fixed-width flow box. Pills wrap left to right in this order:
1. owned, by discovery turn;
2. being studied;
3. not yet occurred;
4. needs prerequisites;
5. moment passed;
6. path not taken.
So in each cell, owned history comes first and the frontier follows. The era column widths above minimise total height, while Modern + Atomic + Space exactly fill the 1,204-px viewport.

Resulting lane heights:
- 21 lanes have 1 row (31 px): Fire, Social Organization, Farming, Mining, Metallurgy, Construction, Seafaring, Philosophy and the Arts, Trade, Textiles & Materials, Water Management, Mechanics, Optics, Electronics, Computing, Nuclear Physics, Relativity & Cosmology, Rocketry, Materials Science, Genetics, Aeronautics.
- 10 lanes have 2 rows (59 px): Foraging, Stonework, Observation, Animal Husbandry, Warfare, Mathematics, Medicine, Thermodynamics, Electricity, Energy Systems.
- Quantum Physics has 3 rows (87 px). Chemistry has 4 (115 px).
- The content is 4,064 x 1,443 px against a 1,204 x 618 viewport: 3.4 viewports wide and 2.3 tall.

WHAT SCROLLS
- The lane grid pans both ways.
- The focus column moves vertically only, and the era header row horizontally only.
- The funding header, legend strip and bottom bar are fixed.
- The description scrolls inside itself.

AT OPEN (scrollX 2,860, scrollY 825)
- 54 pills are visible: 27 owned, 16 of the 26 being studied, 8 moment passed (TH15 is just above the view), 2 not yet occurred, and 1 needing prerequisites.
- The other 10 rows under study are in lanes above the view: Observation, Mining, Medicine, Trade, Textiles, Water Management, Philosophy. So are Construction's revealed rows.

HARD LIMIT
At Unciv's 14-px text a lane needs at least 31 px. 33 × 31 = 1,023 px, against 618. No lane layout at 1440x810 can show all 33 foci at once.
- Filtering to 'Moment passed + Not yet occurred + Path not taken' gives 1,023 px (every lane at minimum): about 20 lanes per view.
- Hiding owned rows gives 1,051 px.
- 'Show unlocks' (two-line pills with Unciv's unlock summary) gives 2,905 px.

LEGIBILITY TOOLS (R142)
- Status filter chips with counts of shown rows. They hide pills and lanes reflow, but lanes are never removed.
- Clicking an era header selects the era: counts and the era rule appear, and the action is 'Collapse era' (a 76-px column of status count chips per lane). Expanding restores it.
- Selecting a focus gives per-focus counts.
- Lane names stay pinned to the top while any part of their lane is visible.

BUILD NOTE
Pill x, y and w are precomputed with DejaVu metrics. The model is in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Uncharted-Horizons/ffab2c8f-97b2-5cca-83ad-f0d7b939b828/scratchpad/dirA_lanes/final.py, and its outputs are /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Uncharted-Horizons/ffab2c8f-97b2-5cca-83ad-f0d7b939b828/scratchpad/dirA_lanes/layout_t226.json and /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Uncharted-Horizons/ffab2c8f-97b2-5cca-83ad-f0d7b939b828/scratchpad/dirA_lanes/layout_t231.json, which hold the eras, lanes and every pill with x, y, w and status. renderVals() places pills absolutely and translates the content by state scrollX and scrollY; it builds no DOM. That also lets it compute the connector-line paths. Examples at open: EL11 is at screen 758,236 (168 wide), QP06 at 758,444 (236), MS02 at 758,537 (281).
concepts.detail_and_actions:
SELECTION
This is Unciv's select, describe, act pattern. A click on any of these selects it: a pill, a focus name, an era header, or the funding header. The description and the action buttons then follow the selection.

When a pill is selected:
- It gets a 2-px white outline.
- Its shown prerequisites get dashed white outlines.
- Unciv connector lines are drawn as an SVG overlay. Each runs from the prerequisite's right-middle to the selected pill's left-middle, 2 px white over a 2-px navy halo, with an elbow at mid-gap and 6-px chamfers.
- A prerequisite not yet owned gets a 2-px dashed line.
- A line to a pill outside the view runs to the viewport edge.
- Only owned and revealed pills are ever joined; Unknown descendants are never drawn (R93).

The description's title line shows the name at 18 px white, the status chip (mini swatch plus label, 14 px) and '· Focus · Era' in #B3B3B3. Column A gives the status and its route (R70) and the prerequisites, each marked met or unmet. Column B gives the conjecture (revealed rows) or the effects (owned rows), plus the price and notes.

ACTION MATRIX (primary / secondary)
1. Owned: primary disabled 'Discovered' (Unciv disables 'Pick a tech' the same way). The description shows:
   - effects in Unciv wording, e.g. 'Builds: Museum. Wonder: The Louvre', 'Opens the Materials Science focus', 'Shows Uranium on the map' (R101);
   - flavour in #B3B3B3;
   - how the row was obtained;
   - any badge explained, e.g. 'Superseded by Railway Network: new Pound Locks can no longer be built', or 'Dead end. Science Advisor: Joule's paddle-wheel warms the water without limit; heat is motion, not a fluid.';
   - for rows that changed the FTL screen (RC01, RC02, QP05, QP12): 'This bore on the question of how to exceed the speed of light', with a link (R137).
2. Being studied: primary 'Fund Electricity', or disabled 'Funded'; secondary 'Grand Endeavour' (R104 as written; the ENDUNOCC package would remove it). Text: 'Under study in Energy Systems: it takes a share of that focus's Insight every turn until it is discovered, faster while Energy Systems is funded. Switching away loses nothing.' Competing rows add one line, shown only when the primary is itself revealed or owned: 'Coal Power Plant, also under study, competes with it: if it is discovered first, Biomass Power Plant will never be developed.'
3. Not yet occurred: primary 'Begin Grand Endeavour' / '(price · turns)'; secondary 'Experiment · 300 Gold' (R102; the Gold figure is a placeholder). Text: 'Awaiting the idea. Its prerequisites are discovered and it may still occur to your scholars; until it does it takes no Insight, however hard Energy Systems is funded.' (R66)
4. Needs prerequisites (R69): primary disabled 'Needs Dirigible/Airship'. Text: 'Seen in use by another civilisation. Needs Dirigible/Airship first (under study in Aeronautics); it cannot be studied or made an Endeavour yet.'
5. Moment passed: primary 'Begin Grand Endeavour' / '(5,340 Insight · 8 turns)'; secondary 'Synthesis (once this era)' (R103). Text: 'Its moment passed — only an Endeavour is certain.'
6. Path not taken: primary disabled 'Never developed'. Text: 'Arch Construction was discovered first, so Corbel Arch/Vault will never be developed: a thing your civilisation glimpsed and let slip.'
7. Endeavour target: primary disabled 'Endeavour under way'; secondary 'Stop Endeavour', with a confirmation saying the progress decays slowly and can be resumed. While an Endeavour runs, every other row's Endeavour button reads 'Replace Endeavour' and asks for confirmation (R107).
8. Focus selected: primary 'Fund Energy Systems', or disabled 'Funded'; secondary 'Add to queue' or 'Remove from queue'. The description gives:
   - counts of shown rows by status, e.g. '4 being studied · 1 not yet occurred · 1 moment passed';
   - 'Tends to help with: power · production' (W19, R44);
   - Insight modifiers with their sources, e.g. '+5% Natural Philosophy (all foci)' (R57/R58);
   - revealed rows from other lanes that this focus also advances, e.g. Farming advances Biomass Power Plant and Biomass/Biogas (R85);
   - the queue, with Move up and Move down;
   - 'Switching loses nothing'.
9. Era selected: primary 'Collapse era' or 'Expand era'. The description gives the entry rule ('An era begins when you hold 6 breakthroughs from it or later: you hold 5'), and the era's counts by status.
10. Funding header selected: primary disabled 'Pick a focus to fund'. The description gives the funding details (see funding).

ARTBOARD 1 TEXT (EL11 selected)
- Column A: 'Your scholars glimpsed this idea, but it did not occur while its moment lasted. A Grand Endeavour completes it for certain.' / 'Needs: ✓ Refrigeration ✓ Electromagnetism'.
- Column B: 'Our physicists suspect that, cooled far enough, some metals might carry a current with no loss at all.' / 'Grand Endeavour: 5,340 Insight, twice its usual price, about 8 turns at 683 a turn. It cannot fail. The price falls as your development catches up with the Atomic era.' / 'Helium Extraction, under study in Chemistry, would give it a head start.' (R60 wording)

OTHER CONTROLS
- Filter chips are aria-pressed toggles.
- 'Show unlocks' switches pills to two lines.
- 'Faster than light' opens the FTL screen (R134).
- Close, or Esc/Back, leaves the screen. F1 or a click on the description opens the Civilopedia, as in Unciv.

DESCRIPTION TEXT RULES
- Revealed rows get conjecture, never effects (R77).
- Prerequisites appear as names with met or unmet marks.
- A token is shown as met by the provider the player owns, e.g. 'HIGH_ENERGY_PHYSICS' becomes 'Quantum Mechanics Formalism ✓'.
- Designer metadata, world labels, forward references and 'cost ×2.5' notes are stripped (R82, R84 and the critic).

- The candidate discovery model: occurrence windows, and an idea occurring does not reveal it.
- Glimpses work as they do now.
- Status 4 is worded truthfully: 'Its moment passed — only an Endeavour is certain'.
- No odds, no hidden meter fractions, no window lengths or closing times.
- Tiers are not shown on revealed rows; RARE and UNIQUE are marked on owned rows only.
- No per-focus spread figures: the funded share and the total spread only.
- Unknown rows leave no trace.
- One funding target at a time.
- A focus queue exists.
- The FTL screen is separate and reached by a button.

CHOICES THIS MOCKUP MAKES ON OPEN QUESTIONS
- Only entered foci are listed.
- The era shown is the era entered by count (R122).
- Endeavours are offered on rows under study (R104 as written).
- Experiment acts on rows not yet occurred; Synthesis acts on rows whose moment passed.
- Competing Solutions are noted only when the primary is shown.

concepts.hidden_info:
1. Unknown rows. Nothing is drawn for them: no placeholders, no '?' and no 'n of N' counts. Chips, era and focus counts cover shown rows only. Era columns and empty cells are global, so a gap implies nothing. Lines join only shown pills. Dependents are never listed beyond what is revealed.

2. Hidden occurrence and hidden meters.
- Only the total spread (171) is shown: no per-focus Insight, spread, spill or 'received' tally.
- There is no stall indicator. The queue rule is stated in general terms.
- No murmurs.
- Rows under study carry no bar, percentage, turns or 'nearly'.
- The 9 to 14 unrevealed rows under study are invisible.
- Exhausted foci are not marked.
- Lane order is fixed (§3), so lanes never re-sort on hidden state.

3. Odds and tiers.
- No chances, odds or bonus figures anywhere.
- Revealed rows of every kind (under study, not yet occurred, moment passed, ghost, needs prerequisites) carry no tier. Only owned rows show RARE or UNIQUE.
- Status-4 text uses only the decided wording. A diffusion clause would be false for UNIQUE rows and so would leak the tier.

4. Windows. No length, no 'closing soon', and no dates for when a row was revealed or when its window closed. Two dates would give the window length, and the length gives the tier.

5. World Truths. Player text is built from a world-derived ruleset:
- Strip FQ codes, probabilities and 'in X worlds' clauses (e.g. MD05's '(~60%)' and TH09's 'FQ12').
- Strip other-world alternatives in prerequisites: '(QP02 atomic, or QM-E04 elemental)' becomes 'Quantum Mechanics Formalism ✓'; '(MC14 (Babbage) or EN01)' becomes 'Vacuum Tube ✓', because MC14 is Unknown.
- Strip 'cost ×2.5'.
- Prices are totals with qualitative notes only, never a breakdown of multipliers. A residual would expose Truth multipliers or a dropped detour margin.
- Competing Solutions notes appear only when the primary is shown. CP13's primary, CP01, is Unknown and is not named.

6. FTL. Strip the FTL text in rows: QP12 'Prerequisite for Wormhole FTL', QP08 'critical node for Warp, Wormhole and Hyperspace', QP05 'prerequisite for the FTL paths', RC02 'prerequisite for all FTL theories', EL11 'some FTL paths'.
- No hypotheses, no power capacity, no signature-field labels.
- The FTL-bearing line appears only on owned rows, after the fact, and says only that something changed.

7. Forward references (critic). Strip 'Prerequisite for...' and similar references to rows not shown: e.g. RK09's 'prerequisite for Asteroid Prospecting (MI12)', EL11's '(NP04)', PH10's 'Prerequisite for Computing'.

8. Hidden per-civilisation state. Nothing shows airship confidence (AE13's disaster chance is never shown), the AGI trust stockpile or the Edison/Tesla modifier.

9. Rivals. Observation and diffusion sources say 'seen in use by another civilisation' or 'learned of from another civilisation'. No diffusion countdown and no list of who holds what.

10. Development. The era band uses the entered era. 'Ahead of its time' appears only as the Endeavour price note (R105). There is no development figure.

concepts.risks:
1. Not all foci on screen at once. 33 lanes need at least 1,023 px; the viewport has 618. At open, 13 lanes and a sliver are visible, and 10 of the 26 rows under study sit in lanes above the view. This is A's structural weakness against 'show all foci clearly' (R2, R143). The funding header and the queue discs keep the current target visible wherever the view is.

2. Panning. The content is 4,064 x 1,443 px. 2,860 px of it is past eras, mostly gold history, and 12 'moment passed' rows live there. Players must use the filters or pan to find them. Unciv shares this weakness, but at 80 techs rather than 250.

3. Deviations from Unciv:
   - The researched-name brown is darkened, and rows under study use navy text, because Unciv's pairs fail 4.5:1 (3.63:1 and 3.46:1).
   - Pills are auto-width flow, not Unciv's fixed 265-px grid.
   - There is no portrait or unlock strip; R79/R81 summaries live in the description and in 'Show unlocks'.
   - Lines are drawn on selection only.
   - Scroll knobs are visible.
   - The funding header and legend strip are additions.
   - The status glyph is not a tech icon.

4. Moment passed and Path not taken are both dark. They are told apart by shape, border pattern, glyph and text tone, not by fill (1.06:1). Their distinctness should be checked on a real screen.

5. Fonts. The layout is precomputed with DejaVu Sans metrics. A wider fallback such as Verdana would overflow the pills. The font stack must exclude it, or the layout must be recomputed.

6. Content corrections. MD20, ES05, RK09 and AE13 are added as illustrations, and CO05 and WA08 are re-statused. The mockup must label them as such. They are plausible but not simulated.

7. The era band moves between A1 and A3 because eras are counted by entry (R122) while development stays Modern. The 'ahead of its time' price note can then contradict the band. This is an open question on era display.

8. The mockup picks answers to several open questions: Endeavour eligibility for rows under study, what Experiment and Synthesis act on, the queue stall rule, the W19 vocabulary, and showing 'competes with' when the primary is revealed.

9. The 101-px description pane holds about 4 lines per column. Long effect texts (CH20, ME08, TH11, EL14) scroll inside it.

10. The radio and the name are separate buttons in a 31-px row. On touch screens this needs the phone layout's 44-px targets.

11. Numbers are illustrative: the 300 Gold Experiment cost and the 5,340 Endeavour price, which I derived to be consistent with 64% at turn 231.

concepts.status_encoding:
Every status is told apart by fill lightness, border style and icon shape, not by hue alone. All icons are inline stroke SVG at 14 px. Every word label also appears in the section headers, filters and description.

OVERVIEW CHIP
- 22 px tall, radius 11, 1.5 px border. Padding 0 3 0 7, then a 14 px icon, a 5 px gap and the name in 14 px.
- After the name comes the era tag: 17 px tall, radius 8, 14 px text, padding 0 5, margin-left 6. Further tags use the same shape.

1. OWNED
- Fill #FFD700 (Unciv ResearchedTechColor, L 0.70, the lightest). Border #B3B3B3.
- Name #6B4300, 6.17:1. Unciv's #9A6210 gives only 3.63:1, so it is darkened.
- Icon: a check mark, stroke 1.9, #6B4300.
- No era tag, because the row sits inside its era band.

2. BEING STUDIED
- Fill #1CAA00 (Unciv ResearchableTechColor, L 0.29). Solid #B3B3B3 border.
- Name #000033, 6.49:1. Unciv's white on this green is only 3.09:1.
- Icon: a half-filled circle (r 5.6, stroke 1.6, left half filled navy), read as "half-way".
- Section text: "Being studied — each takes a share of its focus's Insight every turn".
- No progress bar, no percentage, no turns.

3. REVEALED, NOT YET OCCURRED ("Awaiting the idea")
- Fill #000033 (none). 1.5 px DASHED #FFFFFF border. White name, 20:1.
- Icon: a dashed hollow circle in white.
- Section text: "Awaiting the idea — gets no Insight until the idea occurs; it still may".

4. REVEALED, WINDOW CLOSED ("Moment passed")
- Fill #111111 (Unciv CHARCOAL). 1.5 px SOLID #FFAF00 border (Unciv's past-era amber, L 0.52). White name, 18.9:1.
- Icon: an hourglass outline crossed by a diagonal slash, #FFAF00 (10.2:1).
- Section text: "Moment passed — research will not bring these now; only an Endeavour is certain".
- Telling 3 from 4 without hue:
  - dashed border against solid border;
  - hollow circle against struck hourglass;
  - outline lightness 1.0 against 0.52;
  - separate sections.

ERA TAGS (the colours of Unciv's era headers)
- Past era: #FFAF00 with #782E10 text, 5.18:1.
- Current era: #0E5C56 with white text, 7.82:1.
- Later era: #111111 with white text, a 1 px inset white frame and "»". This doubles as the "ahead of its time" mark. It is computed against the displayed era, so no development figure appears.
- Era abbreviations: Prim, Anc, Class, Med, E.Mod, Mod, Atom, Space.

OVERRIDES AND EXTRA STATES

Endeavour target:
- Overrides statuses 2, 3 and 4. Fill #4893AF (the funding slot's colour, meaning "this is what is funded"), 1.5 px #FFFFFF border, navy name (5.79:1).
- Icon: a filled navy 5-point star. Tag: "Endeavour 64%", navy fill with white text.

Set-aside Endeavour:
- Keeps its underlying chip, plus a tag "Set aside · 40%" (#4893AF with navy text).

Path not taken:
- Fill #111111, 1.5 px DOTTED #8C8CA0 border, name #B8B8C8 (9.65:1).
- Icon: a forked path with one branch cut.
- Tag: "Path not taken" (#252B3E with white text).
- It sits in its era band (history), never in the live sections.

Owned with tags:
- Superseded: a gold chip plus a tag "Superseded" (#252B3E with white text, 14:1).
- Dead end: a gold chip plus a tag "Dead end" in the inverse colours, #6B4300 fill with #FFD700 text (6.17:1).
- Rare: tag "Rare", #7F3200 (Unciv ResearchedFutureTechColor) with white text, 8.9:1. Shown on owned rows only.
- Unique: tag "★ Unique", #3F1046 with white text, 15.3:1. Shown on owned rows only.
- New this turn: tag "New", white fill with navy text. It applies to discoveries, reveals and status changes, so a moment passing this turn also gets it.
- FTL: tag "FTL", #334D80 with white text, 8.35:1. Shown on RC01 Special Relativity.
- Reduced effectiveness (specified; none in this state): tag "75% · traded" or "50% · stolen" (#252B3E).

Specified states not present in this state:
- Not yet reachable (revealed, prerequisites only partly discovered): fill #000033, 1.5 px dashed #8C8CA0 border, padlock icon #B8B8C8, white name. It sits in a small "Not yet reachable" section after Awaiting.

concepts.risks:
1. THE HEIGHT BUDGET IS EXACT
- The live work ends at y 669 of a 697 px fold in this state.
- More live rows push Moment passed below the fold: more glimpses, theory reveals the simulator does not model, or a Determinist Institute.
- The board header, the 22-px chips and the 25-px pitch are already tight.
- Mitigations: the status filter, and the proposed fold of old-era Moment-passed rows (12 here, about 3 lines).
- The measurements use DejaVu Sans; a canvas fallback font changes the line counts (narrower fonts help).

2. DEVIATIONS FROM UNCIV
- Text colours: owned names #6B4300 instead of #9A6210, and navy text on green and steel-blue instead of white. Unciv's pairs fail at 3.09-3.63:1.
- A board scrollbar knob, which the Unciv tree lacks.
- A full-height left column, so the bottom bar spans only the board.
- Era tags inside chips.
- Funding-slot and queue widgets that Unciv's screen does not have.

3. FOCUS RUNS ARE LESS SCANNABLE THAN A GRID
- The run label carries the focus. The alphabetical order matches the list, and the focus view and the phone cards give the per-focus reading.

4. SUMMARIES ARE NOT ON OVERVIEW CHIPS (R79, R81)
- They appear one click away (description) and in the focus view's cards.
- A reviewer may read R81's "rows show a short summary" as requiring them on every chip, which would roughly double the board's height.

5. STATE CORRECTIONS
- The simulator has no lock-outs. Corbel Arch/Vault (owned at T151, after Arch Construction at T38) and Chariot Warfare (T94, after Cavalry Tactics at T89) are shown as Paths not taken. That assumes they had been revealed; otherwise they should vanish.
- Environmental prerequisites are assumed met: Camel (Desert), Elephant (Tropical), Earthquake-prone, Volcanic, Forest/jungle.
- No theory-revealed rows are added, so Awaiting is unrealistically small (3).

6. ERA-HOLD CLOCK (Q6)
- 4 of the 24 closed rows are from later eras: Superconductivity, DNA Structure, Fractal Mathematics (Atomic) and Waste-Heat Recovery (Space). The era-hold clock would forbid these.
- If it is adopted, the Endeavour example should move to Radio or Radar (Modern).

7. ERA AT T231 (Q29)
- The state file says Modern, by development. By the count rule it is Atomic (8 held of 6 needed).
- The mockup follows the count rule and recomputes the » marks against it. The price premium still follows development, so a player could see an Atomic row priced as "ahead" in an Atomic era.

8. OPEN RULES ASSUMED
- Experiment acts on Awaiting rows and Synthesis on Moment-passed rows (Q21). The 340 Gold is illustrative.
- Endeavours are offered on rows under study (current rules; Q17 ENDUNOCC would remove this).
- Paths not taken cannot be committed (Q19).
- The queue advances on revealed work only (Q14).
- W16: per-row "held open while funded" text is deliberately omitted because it would mark STANDARD rows. Q7 stays open.

9. NUMBERS
- 4,150 is the simulator's era price × 4^(Atomic − 5.7) × 2, with scale 1 and no per-city multiplier.
- The queue is invented.
- The W19 texts are placeholders.
- Design inconsistencies to record: "physical foci" (MA05) and "energy research" (TH09) match no focus, so their modifiers cannot be attached and are omitted.

10. DUAL-PATH COUNTS
- Badges count a dual-path row in every focus that reaches it. The badges sum to 29 while 26 rows are under study, which may read as double counting.

11. TWO CLICK TARGETS PER FOCUS ROW
- The radio funds and the name views. That invites accidental funding.
- Acceptable because switching is free. During an Endeavour, a confirmation appears.

12. "NEW" ON A CLOSED ROW REVEALS ITS CLOSING TURN
- This is equivalent to the announcement the critic requires. Over many games it lets players estimate window lengths by tier.

concepts.status_encoding:
The tiles are 18x18 with radius 4, each a real <button> whose aria-label is '<name> — <status>'. Every status differs in shape, and fills differ in lightness. Hue never works alone. Contrast ratios are WCAG values against the card fill #111111.

THE FOUR REQUESTED STATUSES
1. OWNED: solid #FFD700 (Unciv ResearchedTechColor) with no border. Plain means owned at full strength. Contrast 13.5:1.
2. BEING STUDIED (revealed; it draws on its focus's Insight): solid #4893AF (Unciv CurrentTechColor) with a white right-pointing triangle, about 8 px (polygon 6,5 6,13 13,9). Fill contrast 5.5:1. The glyph is 3.5:1 against the blue, enough for a graphic. The tile shows no progress, because the meter is hidden.
3. NOT YET OCCURRED (revealed, prerequisites met, the idea has not occurred, so it draws no Insight): hollow. Fill #111111 with a 2 px solid #1CAA00 ring inside the tile (Unciv ResearchableTechColor) and nothing in the centre. Contrast 6.1:1. Hollow means nothing is flowing in.
4. MOMENT PASSED (window closed): hollow. Fill #111111, 1.5 px solid #B3B3B3 border, and a 2 px #B3B3B3 diagonal from bottom-left (3,15) to top-right (15,3). Contrast 9.0:1. Its label is 'Moment passed'; the full wording, 'Its moment passed — only an Endeavour is certain', appears in the description and the legend.

FURTHER STATUSES THE DESIGN REQUIRES
5. NOT YET REACHABLE (revealed, but some prerequisites not yet discovered, R69): like status 3 but with a 2 px DASHED #1CAA00 ring. Its description names the missing prerequisites.
6. PATH NOT TAKEN (a locked-out Competing Solutions alternative, R71): transparent, with a 1.5 px DOTTED #8A8AA0 border (5.6:1) and no glyph. It is the faded entry, with the least ink. In lists its name is #8A8AA0, which is still 5.6:1, so it passes as text.
7. GRAND ENDEAVOUR TARGET (overrides statuses 2 to 6): fill #334D80, a 2 px #FFFFFF ring (18.9:1), and a white pie in a 10 px centred circle (conic-gradient(#FFF 0 64%, transparent 0)). This is the only tile that shows a fraction, because Endeavour progress is public (R106).

These are specified for the key artboard only; none occurs in this state:
- Known dead end, a revealed rival refuted: status 4's grey outline with a 2 px zigzag crack in #B3B3B3 instead of the slash.

- UNIQUE claimed by a rival: dotted #8A8AA0 border with a #8A8AA0 crown.

BADGES ON OWNED TILES

- UNIQUE: a crown, 12x8 (WM09 Rice Paddy Mastery).

concepts.hidden_info:
UNKNOWN ROWS (R63, R93, R97)
- Tiles exist only for owned and revealed rows.
- Separators sit only between era groups that exist.
- Card height is fixed (78 px) and never depends on the size of a focus's table.
- No 'n of N', no per-focus totals, no '?' slots, no chain lines.
- The status chips and era-bar counts count only rows shown.
- The grid's spare cells hold the Milestones panel, so no empty slot implies a focus still to come.
- Unopened foci (Space Engineering) and other-ontology foci (Quintessic Physics) never appear, not even greyed. A newly opened focus is inserted in §3 order.

HIDDEN OCCURRENCE AND SPREAD (R50, R51, R55, R56, R62)
- Only the funded share and the total spread are shown.
- No per-focus Insight received, spread, spill-over, history or 'almost discovered' murmur.
- An all-gold card (Fire, Metallurgy, Mechanics) is never marked 'exhausted', 'stalled' or 'nothing to study'.
- Funding a focus with nothing revealed under study gives no warning.
- The queue shows order only. There is no stall indicator and no 'will advance soon'.

HIDDEN METERS AND WINDOWS (R65–R67, R86)
- Being-studied tiles are uniformly filled. 'Being studied since turn N' is the only time fact.
- Not yet occurred rows say only 'It may still occur while its moment lasts'. No turns left, no 'closing soon'.
- Moment passed rows do not show the turn the window closed. Together with prerequisite discovery turns, that would let a player measure window lengths by tier. The data's closed_turn is therefore used only to place the changed-this-turn dot.

ODDS AND TIERS (R66, R117, R118, R140)
- No percentages, chances, likelihood words or tier labels on revealed rows.
- RARE and UNIQUE badges appear on owned tiles only.
- Experiment says it 'improves the chance', with no size.
- Synthesis says 'one more chance'.
- Enabling-Truth easing is invisible because difficulty is never drawn.

WORLD TRUTHS (R124–R128, critic R82)
- Rows absent from this world never appear and leave no gap.
- Names are this world's ('Nanotechnology'). World-specific names stay unused until the world type is legitimately known: CH06 Periodic Table is owned, so this world is known to be atomic.
- Prerequisites and focus openers are rendered from the world-derived ruleset, listing only options that are revealed or owned and exist here. MS02 shows no 'QM-E04 elemental'; OP07 shows no QM-E03.
- Stripped from every string: FQ codes, priors ('~60%'), 'validated' conditions still unresolved, 'In Germ worlds…', 'Germ-exclusive.', '— cost ×2.5', W18 pool tags, merge notes, 'Competing Solution' metadata, detour margins.
- 'Competes with X' appears only when both rows of a pair are revealed (ES03-W and ES03). CP13's primary, CP01, is Unknown, so CP13 shows nothing.
- The Endeavour price shows one figure built only from true multipliers: era price, row multiplier, per-city multiplier and prematurity. It never contains Truth multipliers or a dropped detour margin (R127). The engine must keep these out of the displayed figure.

THEORIES (R72, R96)
- A dead end is drawn only after its report (TH09, after TH10 reported).
- QP09 and QP10 appear side by side with identical styling and no ordering cue (alphabetical within their era).

FORWARD REFERENCES (critic)
- Unlocks and Notes text naming a breakthrough that is Unknown or absent here is dropped. Examples: EL11's 'Prerequisite for Fusion (NP04) and some FTL paths'; F07 and WA10 style references.

FTL (R134–R139)
- Only the 'Faster than light' button, and the line 'Bears on how to exceed the speed of light ›' on rows whose discovery changed that screen (RC01, RC02, MA13, QP02; QP08 at turn 231). It says only that something changed.
- No method names, hypotheses, conditions, hosts, power or prototype viability.
- Instruments unlocked by test rows read like any other building.

HIDDEN STATE (R141)
- CP09's trust stockpile, airship confidence and the Edison/Tesla modifier are never displayed.
- CH28's 'Ends the Airship Disaster' is shown only if that disaster has happened to this civilisation.

DIFFUSION (R131)
- A row revealed through rivals says 'word came from abroad'. No civilisation is named, nothing is counted, and no countdown is given.

concepts.risks:
1. Names on the board. Tiles are anonymous until selected. Each focus's breakthroughs are named in the drawer and all of them in Names mode (A4), but the default board does not let you read individual breakthroughs at a glance. If Tamsin wants every name visible without a click, this direction trades that away for the overview.
2. Era inside a card is not labelled: only the grouping, the separators and the current-era plate. The plate is a decoration at 1.3 to 2.4:1 against the card, and the era is always given in text elsewhere. To learn which era a past group belongs to, you select a tile or open the drawer.
3. Small targets. 18 px tiles on a 21 px pitch are fine with a mouse but too small for touch, so the phone opens a sheet instead. The solid ring (Not yet occurred) and the dashed ring (Not yet reachable) differ subtly at 18 px. Check them in preview.py; if they blur, draw Not yet reachable as four corner brackets.
4. The order is history, filled down each column. It reads well (gold on the left, frontier on the right) but is not alphabetical. Finding a focus that an FTL hint names means scanning 33 names, and cards shift by one slot when a focus opens. An A to Z option may be wanted.
5. The board is gold-heavy: 191 gold tiles. The design counts on hollow, slashed and blue tiles standing out by shape at the frontier. If the gold overwhelms, owned tiles could drop to #E6C200, but that weakens the Unciv echo.
6. The data needs correcting before it is drawn (paths not taken, superseded and persists, dead end, RC03, QP09 and QP10, names, stripped text, declared lands). The mockup then no longer matches the simulator snapshot exactly. Record this in the mockup's notes.
7. Four 'moment passed' rows come from eras after the civilisation's development era: EL11, GN02, MA11 and TH15. They could not exist under the era-hold clock that is still open, and EL11 is the Endeavour example. If era-hold is adopted, swap the example for a past-era row such as EN04 Radar or SF12 Ironclad.
8. Era display. A3 shows 'Atomic era' by §2's count rule, while the state file's 'Modern' is the simulator's development era, and 'ahead of its time' uses development. The open question on era display decides this. If the screen shows only one era, the two can visibly disagree.
9. Assumed mechanics, all open:
   - Experiment acts on Not yet occurred rows; Synthesis acts on Moment passed rows.
   - Endeavours may be committed on rows under study (the current rules), not under ENDUNOCC.
   - A path not taken cannot be committed.
   - The queue's stall rule, and whether an auto-advance announcement would itself leak.
   - The W19 wording, and which foci count as 'physical' for Calculus's +15%.
   - Endeavour and Experiment prices are illustrative.
10. Contrast deviations from Unciv: the funded header is #367790 rather than #4893AF, and owned names in lists are gold rather than #9A6210 on gold. Both are needed to reach 4.5:1.
11. Fixed geometry. 5x7 holds at most 35 slots; at 34 foci the Milestones panel loses a slot and two of its entries. The description pane holds 4 lines of 18 px text, so long unlocks (CH20, CH23, ME08, TH11, EL14) scroll, as in Unciv.
12. Deliberate omissions players may miss: per-focus Insight, odds, progress on rows being studied, and the closing turns of windows. Each is withheld to protect hidden information, and the screen should say so in its help text.

scores.strengths: Best fit for R2 and R143. All 33 entered foci (room for 34) stay on screen in a list that never scrolls. Each focus has a radio, Unciv queue discs and a badge counting revealed rows under study, and the funded target appears in three places at once (R48). All 53 live rows sit above the fold in status sections, with the frontier first and owned history below, and every chip shows name, era tag and status (R79, R121). It closes the most leak paths. The queue advances only when the funded focus has no revealed work under study, which settles R51/Q14 without leaking hidden occurrence. A prototype in the slot is unnamed (R135). The per-row W16 'held open while funded' text is omitted because it would mark STANDARD rows. It correctly drops Quintessic Physics from the state file's foci list. Counts cover shown rows only, and there are no per-focus flows, though the state's flow data would have exposed Metallurgy and others. It also admits that a 'New' tag on a closed row reveals its closing turn. Wording for R66, R70 and R72 is good. The dead end is shown only after TH10 reported, and 'Competes with' appears only when the primary is revealed.
scores.problems:
1. It fails the critic's MUST state correction. Risk 5 says outright that no theory-revealed rows were added, so Awaiting holds 3 rows. That leaves R69 (Not yet reachable) and R96 (theory reveals, Space-era rows not yet occurred) specified but never shown. The headline claim, all live rows above the fold at y 669 of 697, holds only for the uncorrected state. Adding the required rows (RC03, QP09/QP10, MD20, RK09, AE13) breaks the height budget.
2. MS02 is measured, and evidently rendered, as 'Nanotechnology / Fine Structuring'. 'Fine Structuring' is the elemental name, so this breaks R128 and R146 in an atomic world.
3. For the Endeavour price (R127), it says only that there is 'no breakdown'. The displayed total must itself exclude Truth multipliers and dropped detour margins. CP13 Analog Computing Mastery is under study and Endeavour-eligible, and its total would show whether the x1.5 margin is there, which tells the player whether CP01 exists.
4. The Moment passed header adds 'research will not bring these now' to the decided wording. It is true, but it is extra copy on a decided label.
5. The '»' ahead-of-its-time mark is computed from the displayed era, so at T231 it disagrees with the premium in the price (acknowledged as risk 7).
6. Environmental gating is assumed rather than declared on the artboard.

scores.strengths: The most Unciv-faithful concept, with a thorough requirements map. Status is told apart by shape: the 'window' body for Moment passed, a ghost pill for Path not taken, and a distinct glyph for each revealed status. Connector lines are drawn only for the selection and only between shown pills (R93). Era columns and empty cells are global, so gaps imply nothing (R63). The action matrix gives every status a route sentence (R70), and statuses 3 and 4 have clear Experiment and Synthesis targets. The Endeavour numbers agree across artboards: 5,340 Insight, 5 x 683 = 3,415 = 64%, and remaining turns are given as an estimate (R106). The R52 confirm popup is correct, and so are the R69 example (AE13: AE02 is under study and ME13 owned) and the theory-revealed additions MD20, ES05 and RK09 (prerequisites checked as owned). There are no per-focus figures and no stall indicator. Text stripping covers EL11, QP12, QP08, RC02, RK09 and the token rendering.
scores.problems:
1. R2 and R143: only 13 of 33 lanes are visible at open, and 10 of the 26 rows under study are off-screen. 'Show all foci clearly and unambiguously' fails at a glance.
2. MS02 renders as 'Nanotechnology / Fine Structuring'. Its 281-px pill at 758,537 is the combined 239-px name plus padding, which shows the elemental name (R128, R146), although the concept claims atomic names.
3. The queue rule 'if the funded focus stalls, funding moves on' is undefined. If a stall counts unrevealed rows under study, the visible advance leaks hidden occurrence (R51 hidden).
4. The AE13 'needs prerequisites' row is counted inside 'Not yet occurred 7'. R66 defines status 3 as prerequisites met, and R69 asks for the two to be distinguished, so it needs its own chip and count.
5. It never declares environmental gating, which is a critic MUST. AH05, AH06, CO07, S05, WA13 and WM09 are shown and need Desert, Tropical, Earthquake-prone, Volcanic, Forest/jungle and River lands.
6. The FTL prototype header shows 'its drive name' on the research screen (R135: only on the FTL screen; R112).
7. 'Show unlocks' does not say that revealed rows show conjecture rather than unlocks (R77). EL11's text 'Helium Extraction ... would give it a head start' gives an effect of a row that is revealed but not owned.
8. W19 'Tends to help with' is not stated to be static. If it is derived from undiscovered rows, an exhausted focus would lose its tags (R44, R125).
9. For the price it says only 'no breakdown', so the total must still be computed without Truth multipliers or dropped margins (R127).
10. It does not note that the EL11 example is invalid under the era-hold clock (Q6).

scores.strengths: The most complete data correction against the critic's MUST. It declares the civilisation's lands for environmental gating. It adds RC03 as a theory-revealed 'Not yet reachable' row (RC02 and MC10 owned, Laser under study, correct), and shows QP09 and QP10 side by side at T231 with no ordering cue (R72; both have their prerequisites owned). It renders MS02 as 'Nanotechnology' and shows CH28's Airship Disaster text only if that disaster has happened. The Milestones panel fills the spare grid cells so that no empty slot hints at a missing focus, which is the best R63/R125 idea of the three. It is explicit that the displayed Endeavour price is built only from true multipliers (R127). All 33 foci and every status are visible on one screen (R2). 'Not yet reachable' has its own chip (R69). 'Competes with' appears only when both rows are revealed, and Experiment and Synthesis are described without numbers (R140).
scores.problems:
1. Tiles carry no name and no era label on the main board, so it fails R79 (name, era and status on each row), R121 (label each row with its era) and the request to 'clearly and legibly show every owned and revealed breakthrough' (R143). Names appear only one focus at a time in the drawer, or in the separate 1888-px Names mode.
2. 'Being studied since turn N' (A2: 'Anaesthesia, being studied since turn 96') uses the state's `since`, which is the occurrence turn. For a row revealed after it occurred unseen, this leaks hidden occurrence and the hidden time under study (R97, R86). CORE rows have since=None.
3. The FTL prototype pill reads 'Prototype drive · <hypothesis name>', which names a hypothesis on the research screen (R135, R112).
4. The queue stall or advance rule is left open (risk 9), so R51's hidden-info rule is unresolved.
5. Fixed 78-px cards hold two tile lines, about 18 tiles. Warfare (26) and Construction (24) overflow in a later game, so it fails R142 at scale.
6. The solid ring (Not yet occurred) and the dashed ring (Not yet reachable) are barely distinguishable on 18-px tiles.
7. It attaches Calculus +15% to Electricity, although 'physical foci' is undefined. That modifier may be untrue (W3).

scores.concept: tree — Direction A: Focus Lanes on Unciv's Era Grid
scores.strengths: The most faithful to Unciv. It keeps the era columns with amber, teal and charcoal headers, the #072E2B band behind the current era, compact tech-button pills with a #B3B3B3 border, the Close | description | action bar, select-describe-act, right-click to queue and double-click to confirm. Prerequisite connector lines are drawn on selection only, which keeps it to Unciv's look without 474 crossing lines. I rendered the at-open view from its layout_t226.json (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Uncharted-Horizons/ffab2c8f-97b2-5cca-83ad-f0d7b939b828/scratchpad/review_lens/a.png). It reads as Unciv's own screen, and every pill is named in full at 14 px with no ellipsis. Its status encoding is the strongest of the three without hue: four fill-lightness steps (0.70, 0.25, 0.084, 0.006, then none), each about 2.3-2.5:1 from the next; a solid, dashed or dotted border; a glyph in each revealed body; and a change of shape for Moment passed (a radius-4 'window' instead of a radius-12 pill). The state mapping also follows Unciv's meanings: blue for under study (Unciv's current), teal for awaiting (queued), charcoal for moment passed (unavailable). The contrast figures check out (5.10, 5.79, 7.82, 9.01, 7.47). The funding header fits its 236 px: three lines with the 80% and 20% chips and 683 and 171. The Endeavour price is consistent across the two states: 5 × 683 = 3,415, which is 64% of 5,340.
scores.problems: It cannot show all foci, which fails the brief's 'clearly and unambiguously show all available foci'. At open, 13 of 33 lanes are in view, so the radios for the other 20 foci need a vertical scroll. 10 of the 26 rows under study (Observation, Mining, Medicine, Trade, Textiles, Water Management, Philosophy) are off screen, and 2,860 px of owned history are off to the left. The content is 4,064 x 1,443 against a 1,204 x 618 viewport, and neither filter solves it (hiding owned still needs 1,051 px). The at-open figures are wrong: the layout puts 51 pills in view (25 owned, 16 under study, 7 moment passed, 2 awaiting, 1 needing prerequisites), not 54 (27 owned, 8 moment passed). The pinned Thermodynamics sliver, 19 px tall, holds no pills at all. The not-yet-occurred teal (#0E5C56) is also the current-era header colour. On the band the dark bodies are close to the background (awaiting fill 1.87:1, moment passed 1.29:1), so they depend entirely on their borders. The EL11 description's column B wraps to 7 lines at 420 px against 4 visible, so the price and head-start lines are clipped. The description text is 14 px where Unciv uses 18, an undeclared deviation. MS02 is shown as 'Nanotechnology / Fine Structuring', which breaks R128 and also sets the widest pill (281 px). The lane is spelt 'Philosophy and The Arts' in the layout file.

scores.strengths: It answers the two halves of the brief most directly. All 33 foci sit in one list that never scrolls, at a 22-px pitch, each with a radio, Unciv queue discs and a badge counting rows under study. The funded target appears in three agreeing places: the blue row, the 372x58 slot shaped like a tech button, and the solid 80% part of the split bar. All 53 live rows are named and visible above the fold. The prototype render (proto3_main.png) confirms they end at y 669 and look polished. Status sections, each with a one-line reason ('gets no Insight until the idea occurs — it still may'), make the four statuses impossible to confuse even for colour-blind players. Within the chips, every status differs in fill lightness, border style (solid, dashed or struck) and icon. Owned history sits in Unciv-style era bands below a 'Owned 191 · 1 unique · 2 rare · 1 dead end' fold cue. Its contrast is the best of the three (lowest 5.18:1). It uses Unciv's palette, its 14/18-px type and its bottom bar throughout.
scores.problems: It is the least like the Unciv screen in structure: no era-column tree, a status-sectioned dashboard and a left column that cuts the bottom bar short. The 'styling' is Unciv's, but the screen does not look like a tech tree. Amber means two things. Moment passed uses a solid #FFAF00 border and an amber hourglass, and 12 of its 24 chips also carry past-era tags filled in the same #FFAF00 (Prim, Anc, Class, Med). The amber border is only 1.32:1 from owned gold. The moment-passed section is the noisiest part of the screen. Focus runs wrap mid-run without repeating their label. In the owned bands of proto3_full.png, Chemistry's Catalysis, Rocket Propellant and Organic Synthesis Attempt, and Mechanical Equivalent of Heat, start a new line with no focus name, so the focus is ambiguous. An era tag on every live chip adds clutter. The 206-px action buttons cannot hold the concept's own labels: at 18 px 'Fund Energy Systems' is 195 px and 'Commit as Endeavour' 199 px, against about 181 px of content after Unciv's 12/13 padding. 'Fund Philosophy and the Arts' would be about 250. The 14-px second lines also overflow: 'Superconductivity's 64% decays' is 227 px and 'Arch Construction came first' 200. In the worst case a focus row needs about 239 px of its 236 (name 166 plus radio, badge and queue disc). The focus rows are 21 px tall, a small target next to Unciv's 50-px controls. Owned rows need 3.4 panes of scrolling, so the brief's 'every owned breakthrough' is legible but not at a glance. MS02 is shown under its combined name, which breaks R128.

scores.strengths: It gives the best overview at a glance. All 33 foci and every one of the 247 rows are on one unscrolled screen, and each card has a radio, so funding is unambiguous: the slot, the blue header and outer ring, and Unciv queue discs on queued cards. Its hidden-information thinking about layout is the best of the three. The Milestones panel fills the spare grid cells, so no empty slot hints at a focus to come, and the card height never depends on how many rows a focus has. Descriptions use Unciv's own 18-px description text. The tile encodings have good luminance separation: gold 13.5:1, blue 5.5:1, the green ring 6.1:1 and the grey slash 9.0:1, all against the card.
scores.problems: The tiles are anonymous, which misses the brief's 'clearly and legibly show every owned and revealed breakthrough'. No name can be read on the board until you select a card (the drawer shows one focus at a time) or switch to Names mode, which is a 1888-px scrolling artboard. Its geometry claim is false. I simulated and rendered the flow (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Uncharted-Horizons/ffab2c8f-97b2-5cca-83ad-f0d7b939b828/scratchpad/review_lens/c.png). Construction (16 rows over 7 eras) and Philosophy and the Arts (15 over 7) need 3 tile lines in the 194-px width and spill out of the 78-px card, and 13 cards need 2 lines, not 10. The fixed 5x7 grid has no room to grow. Its exact description texts overflow the 964-px pane at 18 px: A1 line 4 is 1,043 px, A2 line 2 1,054, A3 line 3 1,051 and A4 1,006, so the 4-line pane needs 5 or 6 lines. The font stack lists Verdana, which is wider than DejaVu and breaks the budget of 166 of 171 px for card names. The current-era 'plate' is a 3-px teal halo on each tile, so a ring-like halo appears on gold and blue tiles. On a hollow 'not yet occurred' tile it makes a double ring (the green ring is 2.53:1 from the teal), which blurs the one encoding that relies on a ring. At 18 px, the solid and dashed green rings (not yet occurred and not yet reachable) are hard to tell apart, and the dotted path-not-taken tile is almost invisible. The board is dominated by 191 gold tiles. It looks like a dashboard rather than Unciv's tree: there are no era columns and no labelled eras inside the cards.

best_ideas_to_graft: From the Ledger: a fixed, full-height focus list (33 rows at a 22-px pitch, holding up to 34 without scrolling) with a radio per focus, Unciv queue discs and a count of rows under study. Use it as the single funding control, and graft it onto the lane grid so every focus can be funded without scrolling the lanes.

From Direction A: the status bodies. Use Unciv's own state colours (blue #4893AF for under study, teal #0E5C56 for awaiting, charcoal #111111 for moment passed); fill-lightness steps of about 2.3-2.5:1; solid, dashed, dotted and thick-white borders; an 18-px glyph slot on revealed rows; and the change of shape for Moment passed, a radius-4 'window' instead of a radius-12 pill. Put these in place of the Ledger's amber-bordered chips to remove the clash between amber for 'moment passed' and amber for 'past era'.

From the Ledger: put the live frontier first. Show status sections (Being studied, Awaiting the idea, Moment passed), each with a one-line reason in place, so all 53 live rows are named above the fold. Put owned history below in Unciv era bands, behind a fold cue: 'Owned 191 · 1 unique · 2 rare · 1 dead end'.

From Direction A: on selection only, draw Unciv's connector lines: 2 px white over a navy halo, chamfered elbows at mid-gap, dashed when the prerequisite is unmet, and only between rows that are shown. They give Unciv's tree feel without drawing all 474 links.

From the Focus Board: use its 33 x 8 status micro-tiles as a minimap or navigator, either for A's 4,064 x 1,443 pan or for the Ledger's 3.4 panes of owned history. Clicking it jumps to that focus and era. It is the only design that shows the distribution of all 247 rows at once.

From the Focus Board: fill the grid's spare slots with a Milestones panel (Synthesis this era, the diffusion phase, Unique held), and never let the layout depend on a focus's table size, so no gap or height can hint at an Unknown row or a focus still to come.

From Direction A: its compact frozen funding header. It fits in 236 x 68: '853 Insight a turn', an 80% chip with the focus and 683, and a dashed 20% chip with 'Spread to other foci 171'. The Endeavour variant has a 4-px bar with ticks at 25, 50 and 75%, and the spread line is unchanged.

From Direction A: pin lane names while any part of their lane is visible, and add an 'era header to collapse era' control (a 76-px column of status-count chips). From the Ledger: single-choice status filter segments that count shown rows only.
must_fix: Focus Board: the card geometry does not fit the data. With 18-px tiles at a 21-px pitch, 9-px separators plus their 3-px gap, and a 194-px inner width, Construction (16 rows over 7 eras) and Philosophy and the Arts (15 over 7) need 3 lines and overflow the 78-px card (rendered and confirmed). 13 cards need 2 lines, not the 10 claimed. The 5x7 grid exactly fills 582 px, so it cannot grow. Narrow the separators, for example to a 1-px rule with no extra gap, or reduce the tile pitch, and re-run the flow.

Focus Board: the exact description lines overflow the 964-px pane at 18 px DejaVu. A1 line 4 is 1,043 px, A2 line 2 1,054, A3 line 3 1,051 and the A4 text 1,006, so 4 lines become 5 or 6 in a 122-px bar. Shorten them or split them.

spec:
# Research screen: final build spec (Uncharted Horizons, Unciv styling)

## 0. Basis

**Concept chosen.** The base is the Focus Ledger, which scored highest on all three lenses (7.5 / 7.5 / 7.5). Ideas grafted from the other two concepts:
- From Direction A:
  - The status bodies: Unciv's own state fills, a solid/dashed/dotted border ladder, a glyph on every revealed status, and a distinct shape for Moment passed (a radius-4 "window").
  - A compact funding header frozen at the top left.
  - Select, describe, act in the bottom bar, with a full action matrix.
  - Consistent Endeavour figures (5,340 Insight; 3,415 = 5 × 683 = 64%).
  - The confirmation popup for switching away from an Endeavour.
- From the Focus Board:
  - The content corrections, including the declared lands.
  - RC03 as Not yet reachable, and QP09/QP10 at turn 231.
  - The rule that the Endeavour price is built only from true multipliers.
  - The status-phrase table.
  - Ability state folded into the funding description.

**Every must_fix is applied:**
- MS02 is shown as "Nanotechnology".
- The queue advances on revealed rows only.
- The FTL prototype is never named here.
- No "since turn N" anywhere.
- The state corrections are applied and the fold re-measured.
- The Endeavour total excludes Truth multipliers and detour margins.
- Not yet reachable has its own chip and count.
- The lands are declared.
- Every focus is visible at once.
- Revealed rows show conjecture, never effects.
- W19 text is static.
- Action buttons are 290 px wide.
- Amber no longer means two things.
- A focus run that wraps keeps its label column.
- The list hint is shortened to 197 px.
- DejaVu Sans is embedded.
- The phone artboard is landscape at 600 virtual px, with 44-px targets.

**How it was measured.** I built a static measurement prototype in Chromium with DejaVu Sans and the corrected data. Every geometry figure below comes from it. It is a measuring aid only, not the build.

**Decisions taken (stated, not reopened):**
- The candidate discovery model: occurrence windows, and an idea occurring does not reveal it.
- Glimpses work as now.
- Status 4 is worded "Its moment passed — only an Endeavour is certain".
- No odds, no hidden meter fractions, no window lengths or closing times.
- No tiers on revealed rows. Rare and Unique are marked on owned rows only.
- No per-focus spread figures: only the funded share and the total spread.
- Unknown breakthroughs leave no trace.
- One funding target at a time: a focus, or an Endeavour in the slot.
- A focus queue exists (R51).
- The FTL screen is separate, reached by a button (R134).

## 1. Global rules

**Artboard and units**
- 1440 × 810 Unciv virtual px: the Large size, 800-px virtual height at 16:9.
- Body and every surface are #000033.

**Font**
- Embed a Latin subset of DejaVu Sans as an inline `@font-face` in `<helmet><style>`:
  - family name "DejaVu Sans UH";
  - source `/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf`.
- Subset command: `pyftsubset … --unicodes="U+0020-007E,U+00A0-00FF,U+2013,U+2014,U+2018,U+2019,U+201C,U+201D,U+2022,U+2026,U+2190-2193,U+2605,U+2713,U+2717,U+25BE,U+00D7,U+2212" --flavor=woff2 --layout-features='kern,liga'`.
  - That gives 21,412 bytes, or 28,552 characters of base64. A test subset is at `/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Uncharted-Horizons/ffab2c8f-97b2-5cca-83ad-f0d7b939b828/scratchpad/final_spec/dv.woff2`.
- Stack: `'DejaVu Sans UH','DejaVu Sans',sans-serif`. Never list Verdana.
- One weight, regular. No bold, no italic.
- Sizes are only 14 px (names, tags, body) and 18 px (labels, titles, buttons). Nothing is smaller.

**Template and code**
- Only one `<style>` block is allowed, in `<helmet>`. It holds:
  - the `@font-face`;
  - the scrollbar knob: `::-webkit-scrollbar{width:10px}`, thumb #334D80 with radius 5, transparent track; plus `scrollbar-color:#334D80 transparent`;
  - `:hover` and `:focus-visible` rules on the fixed class names `uh-chip`, `uh-btn` and `uh-row`.
- Everything else is inline style.
- Every clickable element is a real `<button>`.
- Glyphs are inline stroke SVG chosen with `<sc-if>`.
- No emoji. No script-built DOM.

**Contrast and colour**
- Text contrast is at least 4.5:1 everywhere. The lowest is 5.18:1, the past-era band label.
- Every status differs by fill lightness, border pattern, shape and glyph, and is named in text. Hue never works alone.

## 2. Palette

Hex values come from the style extraction unless marked NEW. Contrast is WCAG.

**From the extraction**

| Hex | Role | Contrast / note |
|---|---|---|
| #000033 | background; studying and badge text | white on it 20.04 |
| #FFD700 | Owned fill | — |
| #4893AF | Being studied fill; funded focus row and pill; under-study badge; funded run-label rule | navy on it 5.79 |
| #0E5C56 | Awaiting fill; queued focus rows; current-era band header; era pill | white on it 7.82 |
| #111111 | Moment passed fill; future-era band; popup | #B3B3B3 on it 9.01; white on it 18.88 |
| #B3B3B3 | chip borders; secondary text on navy; segment counts | 9.56 on navy; 6.70 on #252B3E |
| #334D80 | buttons; Endeavour body; FTL tag; dividers; scroll knob; run-label rule | white on it 8.35 |
| #252B3E | inactive segments; disabled buttons; Superseded and Path not taken tags | white on it 14.06 |
| #65DC72 | button hover, text #404040 (5.94); met mark ✓ | 11.48 on navy |
| #409955 | button pressed | text #000033 there (navy on #409955 is 5.6; Unciv's white is 3.56, a transient state) |
| #FFAF00 / #782E10 | past-era band header and label | 5.18 |
| #7F3200 | Rare tag, white text | 8.90 |
| #3F1046 | Unique tag, white text (Unciv's Medieval era icon colour) | 15.28 |
| rgba(0,64,133,0.75) | queue-order disc, white numeral | 12.71 over navy; 9.63 over the #0E5C56 row |
| #FF0000 | unmet mark ✗ (Unciv Color.RED) | 5.01 |
| #3A98DB | keyboard focus ring, 2 px (Unciv skin selection colour) | 6.5 non-text |
| #19263F | 1-px edges of dividers | — |

**NEW colours**

| Hex | Role | Contrast / justification |
|---|---|---|
| #6B4300 | owned name (Unciv's #9A6210 darkened); Dead end tag fill, with #FFD700 text | 6.17 on #FFD700, where Unciv's own value is 3.63 |
| #9C9CB4 | Path not taken name and glyph | 7.47 on navy; a faded light-on-navy that the extraction lacks |
| #6A6A8C | Path not taken dashed border | 3.87, decorative |
| #FFFFFF | text; New tag fill, with navy text (20.04) | — |

**Fill lightness ladder**
- Owned 0.699, then being studied 0.253, then awaiting 0.084, then Moment passed 0.006 (charcoal window), then Not yet reachable and Path not taken (no fill).
- The Endeavour body #334D80 is 0.076, close to awaiting. It is told apart by its solid 2-px white border, its pyramid glyph, the word tag "Endeavour 64%" and its own section.

## 3. Layout at 1440 × 810

Coordinates are x, y, w × h. Vertical dividers are 3 px: #19263F, #334D80, #19263F.

### 3.1 Left column

The column is 0,0 252 × 810, full height. The vertical divider sits at x 252–255 and runs full height.

**Funding header**
- A `<button>` at 8,4 236 × 76. Clicking it selects "funding".
- Row 1 (y 4–28): a 16-px flask glyph in white at x 11, then "853 Insight a turn" at 18 px white at x 30 (160 px wide).
- Row 2 (y 30–58), the funding pill, 236 × 28, radius 14:
  - Focus funded: fill #4893AF, 1.5 px #B3B3B3 border, navy 14-px text.
    - A 16-px radio-on glyph at x 13: a 1.5 px navy ring with a 7-px navy dot.
    - "Quantum Physics" at x 35.
    - "80% · 683" right-aligned, padding-right 8.
  - Endeavour (A3): fill #334D80, 2 px #FFFFFF border, white text.
    - Line at y 32–49: the 16-px pyramid disc glyph, "Superconductivity", and "64%" right-aligned.
    - Below it, a 4-px bar from x 29 to the inner right edge: track rgba(255,255,255,.25), white fill to 64%, and 1-px #000033 ticks at 25%, 50% and 75%.
  - FTL prototype (spec only): the same body with "FTL prototype" and "38%". It never names the drive or its hypothesis.
- Row 3 (y 60–80): a 236 × 20 pill, radius 10, 1 px dashed #B3B3B3, no fill, 14-px #B3B3B3 text.
  - "Spread to other foci" at x 18.
  - "20% · 171" right-aligned.
  - It is unchanged during an Endeavour.
- Before Specialization of Labor (spec only), the rows read "50% · …".
- A one-off push (R53, spec only) appends " · +N push" to row 1.

**Focus list**
- At 8,84, 236 wide. It is `role="radiogroup"` labelled "Fund a focus".
- 33 rows, each 20 tall with a 1-px gap (pitch 21), radius 10. They end at y 777. Thirty-four foci would end at y 798, so the list never scrolls on desktop.
- Order is alphabetical:
  Aeronautics, Animal Husbandry, Chemistry, Computing, Construction, Electricity, Electronics, Energy Systems, Farming, Fire, Foraging, Genetics, Materials Science, Mathematics, Mechanics, Medicine, Metallurgy, Mining, Nuclear Physics, Observation, Optics, Philosophy and the Arts, Quantum Physics, Relativity & Cosmology, Rocketry, Seafaring, Social Organization, Stonework, Textiles & Materials, Thermodynamics, Trade, Warfare, Water Management.
- Row anatomy (padding 0 4 0 3), left to right:
  - A radio `<button role="radio" aria-checked>`, 22 × 20, holding a 14-px circle with a 1.5-px ring.
  - The name `<button>`: 14 px, flex 1, left-aligned, line-height 20. It ellipsises only as a guard; the measured worst case is 217 of 236 px.
  - Optional items pushed right, each with margin-left 4:
    - the pyramid glyph (16 px), on the focus holding the Endeavour;
    - a "New" tag: 15 tall, radius 7.5, padding 0 5, #FFFFFF fill, navy 14-px text;
    - the under-study badge: min-width 18, height 15, radius 7.5, #4893AF, navy 14-px numeral, padding 0 4. On the funded row it adds a 1-px #000033 ring.
    - the queue disc: 16-px circle, rgba(0,64,133,.75), 1.5 px #FFFFFF border, white 14-px numeral.
- Row states:

| State | Fill | Text | Radio |
|---|---|---|---|
| Plain | none | #FFFFFF | #B3B3B3 ring |
| Funded | #4893AF | #000033 | #000033 ring with a 6-px #000033 dot |
| Queued | #0E5C56 | #FFFFFF | plain ring, plus the queue disc |
| Holds the Endeavour | as plain | as plain | plain, plus the pyramid glyph |

  - Selected: add `box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #FFFFFF`.
  - Hover, on unfilled rows only: #252B3E.
- Hint at 11,786, shown only while the list ends above y 780: a 14-px radio glyph in #B3B3B3, then "funds · right-click queues" at 14 px #B3B3B3 (197 px in all).

### 3.2 Top row of the board

**Status filter**
- At 271,8, height 30. Five segments, each a `<button aria-pressed>`, gap 4, single choice. Pressing the pressed one clears it; none pressed means all are shown.
- Segment style: 30 tall, radius 15, padding 0 11, 14 px. Content is the status glyph, 6 px, the label, 6 px, and the count.
  - Inactive: #252B3E, count #B3B3B3.
  - Pressed: #334D80, `inset 0 0 0 1.5px #FFFFFF`, count #FFFFFF.
- Measured x and width at turn 226:

| Segment | x | Width |
|---|---|---|
| Being studied 26 | 271 | 164 |
| Awaiting the idea 6 | 439 | 179 |
| Not yet reachable 2 | 622 | 182 |
| Moment passed 24 | 808 | 177 |
| Owned 191 | 989 | 124 |

  The segments end at x 1113.
- Counts are the rows of that status in the current view: the whole board, or one focus in the focus view.

**Era pill**
- A `<button>`, right-aligned to x 1424, at 1162,11 262 × 24.
- 1 px #FFFFFF border, #0E5C56 fill, padding 0 10, 14 px white.
- Text: "Modern era · 5 of 6 toward Atomic". At turn 231: "Atomic era · 2 of 4 toward Space".

### 3.3 Board

**Scroll pane**
- 271,46, 1163 wide, padding-right 10, `overflow-y:auto`. The content width is 1143 (x 271–1414).
- The native 10-px knob sits at x 1424–1434. In A1 it measures 211 px (640 / 1942).
- The viewport is y 46–686 (640 px).
- Scrolling is vertical only; nothing scrolls sideways.

**Section**
- `margin-bottom:4px`.
- Header: a `<button aria-expanded>`, `display:flex;align-items:center;height:24px;margin-bottom:2px`. Clicking it collapses or expands the section, and the count stays visible. It contains:
  - the status glyph;
  - the title, 18 px white, margin-left 8;
  - the count, 18 px #B3B3B3, margin-left 8;
  - a chevron, 10-px stroke #B3B3B3, margin-left 6: ▾ open, ▸ collapsed;
  - the reason, 14 px #B3B3B3, margin-left 14.
- Body: `display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:3px 12px;align-items:flex-start`.

**Focus run (hanging indent)**
- Container: `display:flex;align-items:flex-start;max-width:100%`.
- Label: a `<button>` that selects the focus. `flex:none;height:22px;line-height:22px;padding:0 6px 0 7px;border-left:2px solid #334D80;color:#B3B3B3;14px`.
  - Funded focus: text #FFFFFF, border-left #4893AF.
  - Selected focus: text #FFFFFF, `box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #FFFFFF`.

- A run longer than a line takes a whole line and wraps under its first chip, so a continuation line never lacks its focus.

**Order**

## 6. Selection, description and actions

**Selection model.** `sel = {kind: row | focus | funding | era, id}`. Only one thing is selected at a time.
- On opening, the funded focus is selected, as Unciv selects the current tech.
- Clicking a chip or card selects the row. The board does not move.
- Clicking a focus name or run label selects the focus and switches the board to the focus view.
- "× All foci" returns to the overview and selects the funded focus.
- Section headers and era bands only collapse and expand. The era pill selects "era".

**Description rules (R70, R77–R82)**
- L1, revealed rows: "<Source>. <status sentence>".
  - Sources: "Glimpsed by our scholars", "Revealed by <theory>", "Seen in use by another civilisation", "Learned of from another civilisation".

- L1, owned rows: "Discovered on turn N." followed by the effects in Unciv words (R80: object names, "Shows X on the map", "Opens the X focus").
